timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,330–1,340 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is at its strongest level in 23 months (1–2 year low), meaning you need fewer KRW to buy each USD. News reports indicate the won is strengthening ("원화강세 질주") due to export companies selling dollars and broader won strength, making dollar conversion cheaper than it has been in nearly two years.

TIP: If the won continues to strengthen, your monthly $2,000 conversion will become even cheaper in future months—but locking in near these 23-month lows protects you against any reversal in the won's weakness.
